items.title: Critical NGINX Vulnerability Can Crash Workers and May Allow Remote Code Execution
items.summary: F5 has shipped fixes for a critical nginx flaw that lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker trigger a heap buffer overflow in the worker process with crafted HTTP requests. CVE-2026-42533 was patched on July 15 in nginx 1.30.4 (stable) and 1.31.3 (mainline), and in NGINX Plus 37.
items.author: Swati Khandelwal
